We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the sample. We need to infer from NMR data perhaps. We can request proton NMR spectra (which will show methyl signals). Or carbon NMR to see methyl carbons. Use minimal experiments. Probably need to get proton NMR first. Use tool proton_nmr_spectra (requires SMILES? It says for a given SMILES string. But we don't have SMILES. The sample is "the sample at hand". The tool definitions: carbon_nmr_spectra takes no args, measures for sample at hand. proton_nmr_spectra also takes no args? It says takes sample of the compound. The signature: type proton_nmr_spectra = (_: {}) => any; So no args needed. Use it.

Let's call proton_nmr_spectra.
